findings.problem: Installed service can enable TraceLogger through logging.event_trace_file. It emits complete event payload including message text and upstream response bodies. Credential/URL replacement does not remove arbitrary message or response sentinel. Current native privacy test discards operational logging and leaves TraceLogger nil, so all-sinks privacy is unproven and contradicted by code/existing full-trace test. §6 allows only safe fields/random correlation IDs and forbids texts/quotes/sessions/raw upstream causes in logs/spans.
findings.required_resolution: Resolve the explicit conflict between existing full-body operational trace contract and T08 privacy contract; do not silently narrow all-sinks acceptance. A conforming implementation needs content-free safe trace diagnostics and a sentinel test capturing each actual production logger, or an explicit user-approved specification exception.
